name: votc-multi
description: Voices of the Court for CK3, Total War: WARHAMMER III, Total War: THREE KINGDOMS, Hearts of Iron IV, Victoria 3, Europa Universalis V and Stellaris - talk to rulers and heroes with an LLM and let them act in your campaign

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.pack:mod: node wh3_mod/build_pack.cjs && node tk_mod/build_pack.cjs && node attila_mod/build_pack.cjs && python paradox_mods/build_stellaris_effects.py
scripts.test:commands: node tests/dump_commands.cjs tests/.audit/commands.json && python tests/check_commands.py tests/.audit/commands.json
scripts.test:audit: python tests/make_tw_fixtures.py tests/.audit/fixtures && cd wh3_mod/tests && python test_bridge.py --fixtures ../../tests/.audit/fixtures && cd ../.. && node tests/prompt_audit.cjs tests/.audit/fixtures tests/.audit/prompts
scripts.test: npm run test:wh3 && npm run test:3k && npm run test:attila && npm run test:civ6 && npm run test:games && npm run test:commands && npm run test:audit
scripts.build: npm run pack:mod && npm run typedefs && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build
